name: Kuresaka Teru
source:
Teru appears to be a fine, handsome man. His physical fitness and academic aptitude are above average, making him fairly popular with women. He's seen as a likable comic relief among male circles, often compared to the "protagonist's best friend" archetype in manga or anime.

In actuality, Teru is a cunning liar and an egoist. He will lie through his teeth and exploit others remorselessly to elevate his position. He views this as the absolute rule of how the world works, and anyone who does not adhere to it is regarded as a despicable fool.

"Sleeping together means we should date? Come on, that's way too black and white."

[Translated from [url=http://clockup.net/dd/character.html]the official site[/url]]
